title: Inguqulo 0.25 ye-Kyber
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
html:
I-Kyber 0.25 isifikile!

Inguqulo 0.25 ye-Kyber isiyatholakala.

Le nguqulo isekela i-IPv6 kulo lonke uhlelo, yengeza indlela yokuthwebula isikrini nge-DRM/KMS ku-Linux nesithonjana endaweni yezaziso ku-Windows. Iphinde ilungise okuningi ukuze uhlelo luthembeke kakhudlwana futhi kube lula ukulusebenzisa.

Nakhu okugqamile.

Ukusekelwa kwe-IPv6

Uhlelo lwedeskithophu nolwewebhu womabili manje asekela i-IPv6. Ungaxhuma kunethiwekhi ye-IPv6 noma kunethiwekhi esebenzisa kokubili i-IPv4 ne-IPv6 ngaphandle kokushintsha izilungiselelo. Ukuxhumana kuthembeke njengaku-IPv4.

Lesi sici besithuthukiswa unyaka wonke odlule, manje sesifakiwe kule nguqulo.

Ukuthwebula isikrini nge-DRM/KMS ku-Linux

Ku-Linux, usungathwebula isikrini nge-DRM/KMS, ngaphezu kwezindlela ebezivele zikhona ze-X11 ne-NvFBC.

I-DRM/KMS ithwebula isithombe ngqo kumshayeli wesibonisi. Lokhu kuyasiza uma kungekho ndawo yedeskithophu evamile, njengakumaseva angenasikrini noma emishinini yokusakaza engasebenzisi umshini obonakalayo.

Isithonjana endaweni yezaziso ku-Windows

Ku-Windows, iseva manje inesithonjana endaweni yezaziso. Usungabona masinyane ukuthi iseva ikusiphi isimo ngaphandle kokuvula iwindi lemiyalo noma umphathi wemisebenzi.

Ukunqamula isikrini ngesikhathi sokusakaza ku-Windows

Ku-Windows, iseva ethwebula isithombe bese isifaka kukhodi manje isebenza kahle nalapho kunqanyulwa isikrini kusasakazwa. Ngaphambili, ukunqamula isikrini ngesikhathi sokusakaza kwakungayimisa iseva noma kuyenze ivaleke kungalindelekile. Leyo nkinga isilungisiwe.

Uhlelo seluthembeke kakhudlwana futhi kulula ukulusebenzisa

Lezi zilungiso zenza izingxenye zohlelo zithembeke kakhudlwana ekusetshenzisweni kwansuku zonke:

kyctl: Uma ukuxhuma engxenyeni elawula uhlelo kwehluleka, manje kuvela umyalezo wephutha ocacile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kakhulu ukuthola nokulungisa inkinga.

kycontroller: Kulungiswe iphutha ebelibangela ukuthi inombolo yembobo yokuxhumana neseva ngaphandle igcinwe ngokungafanele enqolobaneni yesikhashana, bese izinhlelo ezixhumayo zithola inombolo engasasebenzi.

kycontroller: Kulungiswe ukuvaleleka obekungenza izicelo eziya ku-/login zilinde unomphela lapho imicu yokucubungula ibanga isikhiya esisodwa.

kycontroller: Umjikelezo owamukela ukuxhumana okusha ku-QUIC manje usisingatha kangcono nezimo ezingavamile.

kynput/win32: Uhlelo manje luqapha izinguquko ezilungiselelweni zekhibhodi ngenkathi lusebenza. Okuthayiphayo kuqhubeka kwamukelwa ngendlela efanele ngisho noma ushintsha izilungiselelo usalusebenzisa.

kyclient: Zonke izicelo ze-HTTP eziphuma ohlelweni lwedeskithophu noma kolwewebhu manje zinomkhawulo wesikhathi sokulinda. Lokhu kuvimbela uhlelo ukuba lubambeke uma inethiwekhi ingasebenzi kahle.

Nge-kyctl usungakha okhiye be-JWT ngqo emgqeni wemiyalo. Sekulula ukuphatha izitifiketi namathokheni ngaphandle kwamathuluzi angaphandle.

Thuthukela enguqulweni entsha

I-Kyber 0.25 isiyatholakala.

Thola inguqulo yakamuva ekhasini lokulanda, noma ulande amaphakheji abuyekeziwe ngomzila ojwayele ukuwusebenzisa.

Siyayamukela imibono yakho nemibiko yamaphutha.
